faqs.question: Which entities are legally mandated to conduct an independent Statutory Audit in India?
faqs.answer: Under Section 139 of the Companies Act, 2013, every incorporated company—whether Private Limited, One Person Company (OPC), or Public Limited—must appoint an independent practicing Chartered Accountant to conduct an annual statutory audit of its financial statements. This statutory requirement applies regardless of capital base, turnover volume, or whether the company made a profit or loss during the financial year.

faqs.question: When does a business enterprise or professional require a Tax Audit under Section 44AB?
faqs.answer: Under Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act, 1961, businesses with gross turnover exceeding ₹1 Crore (or ₹10 Crores where aggregate cash receipts and payments do not exceed 5% of total turnover) are required to have their accounts audited by a Chartered Accountant. For professionals declaring income under presumptive schemes (Section 44ADA) claiming profits below the prescribed percentage, a formal tax audit report in Form 3CA/3CB and Form 3CD must be furnished.

faqs.question: How are Input Tax Credit (ITC) discrepancies between GSTR-2B and GSTR-3B resolved?
faqs.answer: Under Section 16(2)(aa) of the CGST Act, Input Tax Credit can strictly be availed only if invoice details are uploaded by suppliers and reflected in the auto-generated GSTR-2B. We execute line-by-line invoice reconciliations, identify default vendors, advise on reverse charge applicability, and draft structured factual replies to departmental intimations such as Form DRC-01A or ASMT-10 notices.

faqs.question: What are the statutory differences between incorporating as a Private Limited Company vs. an LLP?
faqs.answer: A Private Limited Company is the standard legal structure for venture capital investment, angel funding, employee stock options (ESOPs), and DPIIT startup tax exemptions (under Section 80-IAC). An LLP provides corporate limited liability with lower mandatory secretarial filing burdens and no dividend distribution tax complexities, making it ideal for consulting firms, professional practices, and closely held service businesses.

faqs.question: Why are Chartered Accountant certificates mandatory for real estate project developers under RERA?
faqs.answer: Under Section 4(2)(l)(D) of the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, 70% of funds realized from allottees must be deposited in a designated escrow bank account. CA certificates (Form 3) are legally required before funds can be withdrawn, verifying project completion percentages, incurred land and construction costs, and ensuring funds are not diverted away from project execution.

faqs.question: How does CA Kavitha & Associates conduct consultations and maintain client data security?
faqs.answer: Initial discussions can be conducted either in person at our practice chambers in Bairagi Patteda, Tirupati, or through encrypted remote video/WhatsApp channels. In strict accordance with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) Code of Ethics, all financial records, audit workpapers, and corporate disclosures are maintained under total professional confidentiality.
